transport_validation: Public anonymous HTTPS captures use the RoomQuest user agent, bounded response sizes and no credentials, forms, bookings, subscriptions or private APIs. Successful Radegast widget/API capture requests were paced at least 60 seconds apart. Local guarded transport cannot resolve DNS in this environment, so this evidence is a cached real-response parser replay, not a claim of production HTTP success.
description_policy: Keep all normalized publisher narrative text up to 12000 characters; never truncate. Blank, placeholder, room-label-only or oversized narratives are held. Reuse the TEC parser and Squarespace clock parser.
recurrence_policy: Fetch and revalidate the official explicit weekly schedule each run, then materialize a rolling 28-day window. Pauper also obeys the reviewed native season through 2027-02-21 and both holiday breaks. Native biweekly anchors or conflicting clocks are never guessed. Stable IDs include source, program, venue and start.
checkpoint_policy: Radegast uses one guarded GET per native page, preserving its 60-second pacing. Greenbelt uses a complete public organizer HTML manifest, at most two normal detail HTML GETs per chunk, and a separate final organizer manifest recheck. Neither source releases partial rows; completed checkpoints remain dictionaries. Every checkpoint retains immutable UTC started_at and NY date-only window_start; default200 manifest/201event/400diagnostic/900KB bounds apply.

events.description:
Monday at Hex & Co. - Upper West Side
Address:
2911 Broadway, New York, NY 10025
Time:
7:00 PM
Season 7 runs from
October 5, 2026
through
February 21, 2027
. A
calendar of events
is now available.
There are no league weeklies during the holiday breaks:
November 23 - December 6, 2026
and
December 21, 2026 - January 3, 2027
.
Each event follows the standard
Pauper format
, where players compete using only
commons
. Players earn
League Points
based on their performance at each event. The goal is to accumulate points throughout the season and qualify for the
NYC Pauper Invitational
.
For more details on the Pauper format, visit the official
Wizards Pauper Format page
. You can also check the
Pauper Banned and Restricted List
for the current list of banned cards.

events.description:
WILL THIS IMPACT THE GAMING AREA?
Yes, half of the PCs are reserved for the tournament.
There will be LIMITED PCs and console setups from 5 PM - 12 AM.
Join us for the weekly Smash Bros Ultimate tournament, The Bowsery, at OS NYC!
REGISTER HERE!
Check-in begins at
5 PM
. Tournament Bracket starts at
7 PM
.
Please bring your own controller.
Limited Switch Pro controllers are available to borrow with ID as collateral.
The
entry fee
is
$20
in total - $15 for the venue and $5 for the prize pool.
The venue fee is required for both competitors and spectators who are looking to attend the event.
It also allows reentry throughout the evening, as well as playing friendlies with fellow attendees.
Please note that the entry fee for The Bowsery
does not
include gaming
on our PC and console setups.
Only access to the section where the tournament is held.

events.title: All Bops ft. JHN SWN
events.description:
JHN SWN (John Swan) is a New York based DJ/producer, and DJ Instructor at Superior Elevation Records. Swan began DJing in 1999 playing for break dancing events and underground parties throughout the midwest as well as winning DJ battles across the USA and competing in various world finals. His technical skill set and background serving various dance communities allow Swan to mix genres across the funk, disco , house and electronic spectrum with style and grace . His passion music and movement radiates through his performances whether it’ s vinyl, digital or a hybrid live set. Since arriving to NYC in 2008 John has played parties for Soul In The Horn with Natasha Diggs, at The Lot Radio w/DJ Koco, Golden Record events alongside Ash Lauren, Dam Funk, DJ Spinna, Marcellus Pittman, Large Professor, Resolute NYC, House Of Yes, Zulu Nation & Rock Steady Crew anniversaries, and many more while also performing as the turntablist in his live band West Division.
A FeatherBowler Production @featherbowlernyc

events.title: Bluegrass To Brooklyn ft Down North
events.description:
Born out of New York City’s bluegrass scene, Down North is a progressive trio blending the drive of traditional bluegrass with an evolving original sound. Comprised of Tom Gause (fiddle), Sam Chester (banjo), and Landon Trust (guitar), the group first came together through local jam sessions, quickly developing a tight, intuitive chemistry. Known for their dynamic interplay and fresh approach to the genre, Down North often features guest bassists to round out their sound as a full bluegrass quartet.
Brought to you by FeatherBowler

Chop & Quench Special Ops
events.description:
CHOP & QUENCH SPECIAL OPS
@chopandquenchband
Special Ops is a remarkable and compact version of the renowned 15-piece band, Chop & Quench, led by Tony award nominee and Television & Film familiar, Sahr Ngaujah.
Comprising members from the cast and band of the highly acclaimed musical FELA!, each musician in Special Ops is among the finest in New York City, having collaborated with esteemed artists such as The Roots, India Arie, and Elvis Costello, to name a few.
Lead singer Sahr Ngaujah's exceptional performance in the Broadway show earned him a TONY Award nomination and has also showcased his talents in various film and television productions. Together, as a cohesive unit, Special Ops has had the privilege of accompanying iconic performers like Beyonce, Femi Kuti, and Angelique Kidjo.
Brought to you by FeatherBowler
@featherbowlernyc

events.title: Autumn Leaves Story Time and Craft
events.venue_name: Greenbelt Nature Center (in Blood Root Valley)
events.description:
Autumn is a colorful, magical season, so let’s learn more about it.
Autumn is a colorful, magical season, so let’s learn more about it.  Listen to a story or two about autumn leaves, then make your own creative and colorful picture using leaves.  Weather permitting, we will go on a short walk to gather additional leaves.  Recommended for ages 4-8 with adult chaperone.
Additional instructions for participants:  Dress appropriately for the weather conditions.  If it rains, the program will be held indoors.  We will take a short walk if conditions allow.

events.title: Greenbelt Adult Hike - St. Francis Woodlands
events.venue_name: Nevada Avenue Parking Lot (in High Rock Park)
events.description:
Join us as we explore the woodlands of High Rock Park to the New York State parklands of St. Francis Woodlands.
Join us as we explore the woodlands of High Rock Park to the New York State parklands of St. Francis Woodlands. Enjoy fall foliage and scenic views along this extended hike, which takes over 2 hours to complete. Bring water and wear sturdy shoes.
Additional instructions for participants:  Wear sturdy shoes or boots.  Dress appropriately for hiking outdoors in the weather conditions.

events.title: Storytime: Lenape and Corn
events.venue_name: Greenbelt Nature Center (in Blood Root Valley)
events.description:
Join the Greenbelt Nature Center for a pre-Thanksgiving story and craft.
Join the Greenbelt Nature Center for a story and craft.  We will learn about the Lenape Native Americans and some fascinating facts about corn. We will make a corn craft to take home. Supplies are limited.

events.title: Greenbelt Natural History Hike with Dr. Eric W. Sanderson
events.venue_name: Greenbelt Nature Center (in Blood Root Valley)
events.description:
Join Sanderson and Greenbelt Educators for a conversational walking tour that blends Staten Island’s past and present landscapes.
Join Dr. Eric W. Sanderson and Greenbelt Educators for a conversational walking tour that blends Staten Island’s past and present landscapes into dialogue. Together, participants will explore the historical ecology of LaTourette Park in the Staten Island Greenbelt..The Greenbelt is located on the terminal moraine of the Wisconsin Glacier.  During this hike through the central Greenbelt,  see how glacial topography shaped the Greenbelt's past, charted a course for the present day Greenbelt trails, and will help shape a sustainable, resilient future.  Recommended for participants age 12+.
Additional instructions for participants:  Wear sturdy footwear for hiking through rocky terrain and dress suitably for the weather conditions.

events.title: Orienteering Fundamentals
events.venue_name: Greenbelt Nature Center (in Blood Root Valley)
events.description: Learn to navigate through the Greenbelt as people did long before GPS, with a compass and a map!
